summary: Added project-root `reload` (sh) and `reload.cmd` (Windows) launchers that cd to the repo root and exec `pnpm web:update`, which rebuilds the app and restarts the deployed Web instance.
decisions: Root launcher shells out to the existing `pnpm web:update` script rather than duplicating rebuild/deploy logic.
Provided both POSIX (`reload`) and Windows (`reload.cmd`) entry points so the one-command update works on either shell.
errors: Initial `write` of `reload`/`reload.cmd` failed to land on disk under PowerShell (the file could not be found afterward); the assistant recreated both files via `Set-Content` from PowerShell and stripped the BOM from `reload`.
`pnpm check` surfaced pre-existing unused UI hook warnings in three files (AgentStore.svelte.ts, pi-event-translator.ts, SessionCapability.ts, MessageList, and others), unrelated to this change.
